series.name: Light-commercial / multi-split ODU after 2019
series.notes: Official TSP Light Commercial / Multi-Split outdoor unit table (post-2019).

meaning.ur: Indoor/outdoor unit ke darmiyan rabta toot gaya

causes.en: Loose, broken or wrongly landed wiring between indoor and outdoor units.
causes.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ke darmiyan wiring dheeli, tooti ya ghalat lagi hui ho

causes.en: Faulty indoor/outdoor control board or S-line driver.
causes.ur: Indoor/outdoor control board ya S-line driver kharab hona

solutions.en: Switch off power, wait one minute, check L/N/S/GND wiring and re-terminate securely.
solutions.ur: Power off karke aik minute ruken, L/N/S/GND wiring check karke mazboot se dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Power-cycle and verify outdoor PCB status LEDs; replace the faulty board if the link still fails.
solutions.ur: Power cycle karein aur outdoor PCB ke status LED check karein; agar rabta phir bhi na bane to kharab board tabdeel karein

notes.en: Scope: light-commercial / multi-split outdoor unit, 3rd GEN (post-2019). Display on ODU PCB or passed to indoor/wired controller.
notes.ur: Yeh entries light-commercial / multi-split outdoor unit, 3rd GEN (post-2019) ke hain. Code ODU PCB par nazar aata hai ya indoor/wired controller ko bheja jata hai.

title.en: Outdoor fan speed outside normal range
title.ur: Outdoor fan speed normal range se bahar chal raha hai

meaning.en: The outdoor fan speed is operating outside of the normal range
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan ghair mamooli raftar par chalna ya phase error

causes.en: Indoor/outdoor fan motor stuck, obstructed, or Hall feedback missing.
causes.ur: Fan motor atka hua ya ruka hua, ya Hall feedback nahi aa raha

causes.en: Fan connector or PCB drive circuit fault.
causes.ur: Fan connector ya PCB drive circuit kharab hona

solutions.en: Power off, spin the fan by hand for binding, clear debris, and check connectors.
solutions.ur: Power off karke fan ko haath se ghumayein, debris saaf karein aur connectors check karein

solutions.en: Replace the fan motor if windings/feedback fail; otherwise replace the control board.
solutions.ur: Agar motor ki windings/feedback kharab ho to fan motor tabdeel karein, warna control board tabdeel karein

notes.en: Scope: light-commercial / multi-split outdoor unit, 3rd GEN (post-2019). Display on ODU PCB or passed to indoor/wired controller.
notes.ur: Yeh entries light-commercial / multi-split outdoor unit, 3rd GEN (post-2019) ke hain. Code ODU PCB par nazar aata hai ya indoor/wired controller ko bheja jata hai.

title.en: Outdoor PCB main chip gets no EEPROM feedback
title.ur: Outdoor PCB ka main chip EEPROM se feedback nahi leta

meaning.en: Outdoor PCB main chip does not receive feedback from EEPROM chip
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ki main chip ko EEPROM se jawab nahi milna

causes.en: Memory chip data on the control board is corrupted or the chip is not seated.
causes.ur: Control board par memory chip ka data kharab hona ya chip sahi tareeqe se baithi na ho

causes.en: Board-level fault after power surges or interrupted supply.
causes.ur: Voltage ke achanak urne ya supply cutne ke baad board level ki kharabi.

solutions.en: Power off at the isolator for about 10 minutes, then restart to attempt a reset.
solutions.ur: Isolator se 10 minute ke liye band karke dobara on karke reset karwayein.

solutions.en: If the code returns, reseat or replace the EEPROM/indoor PCB as per the service manual.
solutions.ur: Agar code wapas aaye to EEPROM/indoor PCB ko dobara lagayein ya tabdeel karein

notes.en: Scope: light-commercial / multi-split outdoor unit, 3rd GEN (post-2019). Display on ODU PCB or passed to indoor/wired controller.

title.en: Outdoor temp sensor open/short (T3, T4, TP, T2B, TH)
title.ur: Outdoor temperature sensors open/short ho gaye (T3, T4, TP, T2B, TH)

meaning.en: Open circuit or short circuit of outdoor temperature sensor(T3, T4, TP, T2B,TH)
meaning.ur: Outdoor temperature sensor (T3, T4, TP, T2B, TH) kharab hona

causes.en: Sensor connector loose, wire chafed, or sensor element open/shorted.
causes.ur: Sensor connector dheela, wire kati hui, ya sensor element open/short hona

causes.en: Moisture or rodent damage at the sensor harness.
causes.ur: Sensor harness mein nami ya chuha ki kharabi.

solutions.en: Check plug seating and measure sensor resistance against the manual table; reseat or replace.
solutions.ur: Plug check karein, manual ke mutabiq sensor ki resistance naappein, dobara lagayein ya tabdeel karein

solutions.en: If resistance is open/shorted with a good connector, replace the thermistor.
solutions.ur: Agar connector theek ho phir bhi resistance open/short ho to thermistor tabdeel karein

notes.en: Scope: light-commercial / multi-split outdoor unit, 3rd GEN (post-2019). Display on ODU PCB or passed to indoor/wired controller.
notes.ur: Yeh entries light-commercial / multi-split outdoor unit, 3rd GEN (post-2019) ke hain. Code ODU PCB par nazar aata hai ya indoor/wired controller ko bheja jata hai.

title.en: IPM malfunction or IGBT over-strong current protection
title.ur: IPM kharabi ya IGBT zyada current se protection

meaning.en: IPM malfunction or IGBT over-strong current protection
meaning.ur: IPM kharab ya IGBT power module mein zyada current

causes.en: Mains voltage out of range, dirty condenser, blocked airflow, or refrigerant charge issue.
causes.ur: Supply voltage ghair mamooli, ganda condenser, ruki hui hawa ya refrigerant charge ki masla

causes.en: Compressor, IPM module or board failure under stress.
causes.ur: Compressor, IPM module ya board par dbaav ki wajah se kharabi

solutions.en: Stop the unit, check supply voltage with a meter, and inspect outdoor airflow/coil.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, meter se voltage check karein aur outdoor ki hawa/coil dekhein.

solutions.en: Qualified technician: verify pressures, windings, and module before replacing parts.
solutions.ur: Technician: parts badalne se pehle pressure, windings aur module check karein
